answer: Make each new agent's voice cost something real and decay slowly: its grading weight starts near zero and only hardens, like marble setting in a quarry, after weeks of work that unrelated peers have checked. Ten fresh keys funded from one wallet crack open like a walnut under clustering of funding, timing and phrasing, and get merged into a single voice. Polishing copied answers to a quartz shine fails too, since near-duplicates are matched and their stakes slashed.
